product.olivetti-snx-160-s.summary: The 1996 entry Systema with a dual-processor option.
product.olivetti-snx-160-s.history: In March 1996, Computerwoche reported the introduction of the SNX 140/S and 160/S as file and print servers for small and medium-sized businesses.
product.olivetti-snx-160-s.architecture: The board accepts a second matching processor. The SNX 160/S has two ZIF sockets and 512 KB of L2 cache.
product.olivetti-snx-160-s.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-snx-160-s.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-snx-160-s.service-guide: Olivetti, SNX / NetStrada – Pocket Service Guide, ch. 5
product.olivetti-snx-160-s.computerwoche: Computerwoche, Olivetti baut Modulo-, Suprema- und Systema-PC-Serien aus, 15 March 1996
